source_caption:
A/C to Deadline, a 'Hooters' origin movie is officially in the works.

The Film is being independently produced by the chain’s original founding partners and is being directed by Emmy-nominated filmmaker Jon Rosenbaum (Woody Woodpecker Goes to Camp, Benchwarmers 2: Breaking Balls) off a screenplay by Ed Droste, Phil Olson and Chuck Melcher. The film will explore the story of the sports bar chain known for its servers' revealing uniforms. Casting is underway, led by casting directors Lisa London and Catherine Stroud of London/Stroud Casting.
